title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa Senior Full Stack Developer com forte atuação em backend e experiência em contextos de pagamentos para compor o time de tecnologia.


Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades utilizando ReactJS e APIs RESTful, com forte atuação em backend utilizando Node.js e Express, principalmente em soluções relacionadas ao contexto de pagamentos;
  • Escrever códigos limpos, de alta qualidade e fácil manutenção seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de tecnologia (Engenharia, Produto e Design) para o sucesso dos projetos;
  • Participar ativamente em discussões de arquitetura e tecnologias;
  • Realizar code reviews, ajudando outros desenvolvedores a melhorar a qualidade do código;
  • Garantir que a documentação do código e arquitetura esteja sempre atualizada.


Requisitos técnicos:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de Backend e Frontend, com maior profundidade em backend;
  • Experiência em Typescript e API REST;
  • Experiência ou vivência com integrações e contextos de pagamentos (gateways, billing, recorrência, webhooks ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais;
  • Orquestração de containers (Docker e docker-compose);
  • Conhecimento em Styled Components e Context API;
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git.


Desejável:

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência em times de desenvolvimento de software ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e ferramentas de integração contínua;
  • Conhecimento de Design Patterns;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação;
  • Boa habilidade de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico.


Modelo de Contratação:

PJ


Oferecemos :

Cartão flexível de benefícios.

Rotina remota de trabalho;

Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;

Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.



Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa desenvolvedora sênior e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se candidate na oportunidade.

title: Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.


What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with Node.js
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Nest.js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications.
  • Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management.
  • Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.g., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies.
  • Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling.
  • Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: People Business Partner
description:
This role is part of the People Success area and acts as a strategic partner to leaders and teams, ensuring a high-impact, culture-aligned employee experience throughout the full journey. The role owns end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, provides ongoing support and coaching to organizational leaders, and leads initiatives related to culture, benefits, and corporate social responsibility (CSR), always with a continuous improvement and scalability mindset.


What You'll Do:

  • Own and lead end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and culture-aligned employee experience.
  • Act as a strategic partner to leaders, providing ongoing guidance, coaching, and support on team health, performance, engagement, and complex people situations.
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers, delivering high-quality internal client support with a strong service mindset.
  • Drive and execute culture and engagement initiatives that strengthen Qubika’s values and employee experience across teams.
  • Identify improvement opportunities through feedback and data, and implement scalable solutions to enhance People processes and the overall employee lifecycle.


What we expect from you:


  • Experience working for Brazilian companies in Brazil. SP/Curtiva Preferred
  • 4+ years of experience in HRBP/People Partner/HR Generalist roles with strong leadership exposure within tech companies .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field; advanced degree is a plus.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). Fluent Spanish nice to have.
  • Experience working in dynamic, multicultural and/or distributed environments is a plus.
  • Previous experience with Workday is a plus.


Soft Skills

  • Clear, empathetic, and assertive communication.
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
  • Strategic mindset with strong execution.
  • Autonomy, prioritization, and multi-stakeholder management.
  • Analytical thinking and Data-driven approach to People practices.


What we offer:

  • Exciting and innovative projects for disruptive start-ups and world-class companies.
  • A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community.
  • A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career.
  • Enjoy a range of benefits at Qubika, including flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, language lessons, travel opportunities, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Job Title: Salesforce Administrator

Location: Remote (LATAM)

Duration: 6months

Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Salesforce Administrator to manage, configure, and optimize our Salesforce platform. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions while ensuring data integrity, automation efficiency, and user adoption.


Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and maintain the Salesforce platform including user setup, profiles, roles, and permissions
  • Design and implement custom objects, fields, validation rules, workflows, and flows
  • Build and manage reports and dashboards for business insights
  • Automate business processes using Flow, Process Builder (legacy), and approval processes
  • Perform data management including imports, deduplication, and data quality monitoring
  • Support Sales, Service, and other cloud users with issue resolution and enhancements
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and translate business requirements
  • Ensure system security, compliance, and best practices
  • Manage releases, change sets, and deployments
  • Provide user training and drive Salesforce adoption


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 4–7 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator
  • Strong expertise in:
  • Salesforce configuration (Objects, Fields, Layouts)
  • Flow Builder (must-have)
  • Reports & Dashboards
  • Data Loader / Data Import Wizard
  • Understanding of Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud
  • Knowledge of security model (Profiles, Roles, Sharing Rules)
  • Experience with data quality and governance
  • Familiarity with integration concepts (REST/SOAP APIs – basic level)
  • Strong problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills


Primary Skills

1.Salesforce Platform hands-on experience

2.Salesforce admin expertise (Security Model, Data Model, End to End configuration, Flows etc)

3. Salesforce Admin Cert

4. Reports & Dashboards – Handson


Secondary Skills

1. Sales Cloud, Service Cloud

2. Business analysis

3. Stakeholder Management

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

At Company 86, we specialize in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and advanced AI implementation to deliver measurable and secure results for our clients. With decades of real-world experience, we focus on practical and future-ready outcomes through strategy, design, and delivery. Our mission is to ensure successful, transformative solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses. We are committed to innovation and delivering cutting-edge expertise through our core principles: Cyber, Transformation, and AI.


Role Description

I’m working with a small, high-trust team that’s hiring 2 Staff / Senior Staff Software Engineer  — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes real ownership, and prefers defining problems rather than waiting for tickets. This is not  a “tasks + Jira board” role. You’d be shaping architecture, shipping meaningful systems, and using agentic coding tools (Cursor / Claude Code, etc.) as true force multipliers — not crutches.

You’d be a great fit if you:

 • Own outcomes end-to-end — not just code

 • Work comfortably across Python + TypeScript / React

 • Have experience integrating LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)

 • Enjoy making smart trade-offs with imperfect info

 • Prefer small, high-impact teams over large, process-heavy environments

It’s ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

description:

Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de Desenvolvimento Java , em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead ), que desejam atuar em projetos desafiadores, ambientes de alta performance e contextos tecnológicos inovadores.

  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares em ambientes ágeis.

  • Interesse em qualidade de código, design patterns e boas práticas de engenharia.

  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe;
  • Proatividade e vontade de aprender continuamente;
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas e pensar de forma analítica;
  • Autonomia e organização na gestão do próprio trabalho;
  • Interesse por inovação e desafios tecnológicos.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Desenvolvimento Java AWS - Pleno - 124105
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Desenvolvimento Salesforce Sênior


Requisitos:

  • Desenvolvedor Java experiente e com conhecimentos em Amazon Web Services (AWS) para se juntar à nossa equipe de tecnologia. O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações robustas e escaláveis em Java, integrando-as com serviços na nuvem AWS.
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com Java 8/ 11+, incluindo frameworks como Spring, Spring boot, Hibernate ou Java EE. Proficiência em AWS, com experiência prática em serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, IAM, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, SSM entre outros. Conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços e práticas de desenvolvimento orientado a serviços (SOA). Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (por exemplo, PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB). Familiaridade com ferramentas de CI/CD e automação, como Jenkins, GitLab CI ou AWS CodePipeline. Conhecimento em containers e orquestração, como Docker, EKS e Kubernetes. Experiência com práticas de DevOps e infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando ferramentas como Terraform ou AWS CloudFormation. Habilidade para resolver problemas complexos de forma eficiente e colaborativa. Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas relacionadas. Diferenciais: Certificações AWS, como AWS Certified Developer ou AWS Certified Solutions Architect. Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban). Conhecimento em segurança na nuvem e boas práticas de proteção de dados. Experiência em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful. Contribuições para projetos open source ou participação em comunidades técnicas.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
  • Experiência com Orchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;
  • Conhecimento em Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) será considerado um diferencial, especialmente para gerenciar contratos ao longo de seu ciclo de vida, da criação à renovação e fechamento;


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida.


Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Kofax Developer (French Speaker) - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • 3+ years with Kofax;
  • Experience with Kofax TotalAgility (KTA) and Kofax Insight (certified if possible);
  • English: B2 (spoken and written);
  • French: B2 (spoken and written);
  • Willing to relocate to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid in Lisbon after the work visa is completed.

title: Secretaria Clinica odontológica
description:
Descrição da Empresa: Clinica Odontológica de médio porte localizado na Área Octogonal, Brasília-DF.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos à procura de uma Secretaria Clínica Odontológica para atuar em nossa equipe em Brasília, Distrito Federal. Este cargo requer o gerenciamento de tarefas administrativas relacionadas ao funcionamento diário da clínica, como o agendamento de consultas, organização de documentos e atendimento a pacientes. Outras responsabilidades incluem suporte direto à equipe odontológica, garantindo um ambiente organizado e eficiente. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer presença no local.

Qualificações

  • Habilidades Administrativas: Experiência em tarefas administrativas e organizacionais, como gestão de documentos e controle de agenda.
  • Comunicação: Boa habilidade verbal e escrita, para interagir de forma clara e cortês com pacientes e a equipe da clínica.
  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Experiência com atendimento ao público, garantindo uma experiência excepcional e demonstrando empatia e profissionalismo.
  • Suporte Administrativo: Conhecimento em assistência administrativa e secretarial para dar suporte ao time odontológico nas rotinas da clínica.
  • Requisitos adicionais, como cursos voltados à área odontológica, serão considerados diferenciais.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Build AI-Powered Computer-Vision Products with Us


Our company specializes in AI-driven computer vision solutions for the wood industry, enhancing production efficiency and sustainability. Collaborating with the world's leading sawmills, we play a pivotal role in supporting the shift to a carbon-neutral future. Our focus is on innovation and technology, fostering automation to minimize waste.


We work in small, highly skilled teams that embody a startup-like mentality, embracing diverse cultures from Belgium, Romania, Spain, and Brazil. As a horizontal organization, we value initiative and self-drive. Our development team boasts members with over 15 years of experience, including key figures such as founding members and team leads who have successfully guided startups to exits exceeding 150 million dollars.


We're Looking for You!


Are you excited to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment? Do you want to work with experienced professionals who can mentor you? If yes, we'd love to have you join our team.


Your Role:


  • Work in an Agile environment with a team of experienced developers, researchers, and business analysts
  • Architect and develop highly performant software components, with an emphasis on scalability and robustness
  • Build back-end components for web-based applications built around the product
  • Actively participate with ideas for improving the product
  • Write automated tests and document your code
  • Participate in code review sessions
  • Engage in knowledge transfer and coaching sessions – you’ll have the opportunity to understand how the entire ecosystem works and contribute to components of the project which you might be interested in – AI, computer vision, HPC.
  • Work and innovate with R&D to integrate research results into the final product


What We Need from You:


Every Neural Grader team member is an important asset to us and makes their mark on the projects they’re working on. Here is what we’re looking for in this role:


  • Technical Bachelor's degree
  • Have a very high understanding of OOP concepts and comprehensive knowledge across programming fields
  • Self-driven and able to drive tasks to completion independently
  • Pragmatic and goal-oriented
  • Very good technical knowledge and work experience with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, SQL
  • Ability to architect complex features, focusing on performance
  • Image processing/computer vision skills are a plus


What We Offer


  • Flat structure—initiative beats hierarchy
  • Competitive salary
  • Training, coaching, and certifications
  • Periodic performance evaluations
  • Performance or special occasion bonuses
  • Remote work
  • Team buildings
  • Plus, a high-tech lab with industrial cameras and lasers


Ready to Apply?

We're excited to hear from you! Send us your application and let's start the conversation about your future with us.

title: Arquiteto Sênior SAP Basis e Infraestrutura
description:
Sobre a Empresa



Você atuará como referência técnica em projetos estratégicos e ambientes de alta complexidade. Será responsável por impulsionar a evolução técnica do time, fortalecer o framework de conhecimento e certificações, além de apoiar iniciativas críticas e o time de Suporte (MS).



Sobre o Papel



Procuramos um(a) profissional com visão de arquitetura, mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo e forte interesse em tecnologias emergentes como SAP BTP, IA, SAP Activate e integrações com Azure, AWS e GCP.



Responsabilidades



  • Liderar iniciativas técnicas SAP Basis, incluindo migrações (S/4HANA, ECC, PI/PO, etc), upgrades e projetos críticos em ambientes Cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Conduzir assessments técnicos e de performance (tunning, banco de dados, arquitetura, etc) e definir recomendações de otimização.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e ponto de escalonamento, oferecendo suporte Nível 3 e 4, inclusive em situações de crise (war rooms) em ambientes complexos.
  • Desenvolver e manter arquitetura SAP, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança, alta disponibilidade e aderência às melhores práticas da SAP e dos hyperscalers.
  • Apoiar os times de suporte (Managed Services) e Projetos (Professional Services), incluindo manutenção, melhorias, auditorias, mudanças, atualizações e rotinas operacionais em SAP ECC, S/4 e RISE.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders internos/externos, garantindo alinhamento estratégico, qualidade das entregas e orientação técnica ao time Basis.
  • Promover inovação e aprendizagem contínua, pesquisando novas tecnologias (IA, BTP, ALM, accelerators Azure/AWS/GCP) e disseminando conhecimento para o time.


Qualificações



  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada.
  • Proficiência avançada em português, e espanhol (intermediário).
  • Experiência Sênior em SAP Basis.


Habilidades Necessárias

title: [Tech] Engenharia de Software Backend Pleno - Java
description:
Descrição da vaga

Atuar em equipe ágil no desenvolvimento e sustentação de produtos digitais, entregando valor de forma contínua e com qualidade, utilizando boas práticas de engenharia de software, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a estabilidade das soluções em produção.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, colaborando para manter um ambiente saudável e produtivo entre os membros da equipe;
  • Desenvolver e evoluir os produtos com foco em qualidade, utilizando testes automatizados e realizando revisões de código entre pares (code review);
  • Corrigir eventuais problemas nos sistemas com base na priorização definida pelo Product Owner, assegurando a satisfação dos clientes e usuários;
  • Realizar deploy em ambiente de produção utilizando processos de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD), garantindo a estabilidade da aplicação;
  • Propor melhorias técnicas e participar ativamente da evolução da arquitetura dos sistemas;
  • Garantir a segurança e a qualidade das entregas, respeitando os padrões estabelecidos pela equipe;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas parceiras (DevOps, QA, Produto) na busca por soluções robustas e escaláveis.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo ou cursando na área de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Programação orientada a objetos (POO);
  • Linguagem Java (preferencialmente versão 8 ou superior);
  • Spring Framework (Core, Boot, Data, etc.);
  • Criação de APIs RESTful;
  • Controle de versionamento com Git;
  • Arquitetura baseada em microsserviços.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Vivência com mensagerias (Kafka, RabbitMQ);
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Desenvolvimento orientado a testes (TDD, BDD);
  • Criação de testes de integração e de carga;
  • Utilização de containers (Docker);
  • Orquestração com Kubernetes;
  • Banco de dados NoSQL (MongoDB);
  • Uso de cache (Redis);
  • Vivência com atuação em times ágeis e em ambientes de alta disponibilidade.

title: Senior Kotlin Software Engineer
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re looking for a Senior Kotlin Software Engineer to join our team. You’ll design, build, and maintain backend services that power our applications, working closely with frontend and product teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure APIs.


What you will do :

  • Design and implement backend services using Kotlin and Spring Boot.
  • Build and maintain REST APIs consumed by our applications.
  • Work with PostgreSQL databases, ensuring performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with product, frontend, and QA teams to deliver high-quality features.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code following best practices.
  • Contribute to system design and architecture discussions.


What we expect from you:

  • 5 years of experience in software engineering.
  • Deep expertise with Kotlin and Spring Boot, including complex system design.
  • Proven experience designing scalable backend architectures.
  • Strong focus on performance, security, and reliability.
  • Ability to mentor junior/mid engineers and lead technical initiatives.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability practices.
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana).


Additional Information:

  • CLT employment type;
  • Working schedule follows the Portugal time zone.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: P2P Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

• Global Scale: We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets.

• Industry Leader: Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, supporting a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets.

• Our Team: Backed by thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally.

• Our Culture: We operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments.


About the role

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented P2P Merchant Operations Manager to join our dynamic operations team. In this role, you will be a key driver of our P2P ecosystem, focusing on nurturing relationships with existing platform merchants, expanding our network by onboarding new high-quality merchant clients, and maintaining platform integrity through careful application reviews and market research. If you are a proactive team player with a deep understanding of the crypto P2P landscape and the resilience to thrive under pressure, we'd love to have you on board.


Responsibilities:

1. Maintain relationships with merchants and users on the platform.

2. Develop and expand new merchant clients.

3. Review and approve merchant applications.

4. Conduct market research.

5. Assist with other related operational tasks.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor’s degree or above, with over 2 years of relevant P2P work experience in the cryptocurrency industry.

2. Familiar with internet platform resource management processes and possess basic data analysis skills.

3. Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.

4. Detail-oriented, responsible, and able to work well under pressure.

title: Especialista em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?



O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework.



✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais

Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura

• Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design

• Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS)

• Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering

Azure Files

• Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS)

• Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory

• Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso

• Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises

• Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup

Azure Networking – Conceitos principais

• Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP

• Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

• Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

• Private Endpoints e service endpoints

• Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure

✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações

• Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking

• Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher

• Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros

• Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede

Logs e análises

• Integração com Log Analytics Workspace

• Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL)

• Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura

• Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais

✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência

Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios

• Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files

• Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault

• Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração

• Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade

Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres

• Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware)

• Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade

• Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos

• Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde

✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade

• Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking

• Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

• Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC

• Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags

• Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas


Automação e integração (desejável):

• Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep

• Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps

• Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC)

• Runbooks operacionais padronizados

✅ Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente

• Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica

• Projetar e validar arquiteturas de armazenamento e rede do Azure

• Liderar workshops técnicos e revisões de arquitetura

• Apoiar as fases de integração, adoção e otimização

• Solucionar problemas em cenários complexos de armazenamento e rede

• Colaborar com Gerentes de Contas do Cliente (CSAMs), equipes de entrega e parceiros

✅ Perfil de Experiência

• Experiência em projetar e operar soluções de infraestrutura do Azure

• Experiência prática com Azure Storage, Azure Files e Redes

• Experiência com cargas de trabalho de escala empresarial ou de missão crítica

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de governança e monitoramento do Azure

• Fortes habilidades de solução de problemas e relacionamento com o cliente



Contratação CLT

Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens esporádicas)



O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;


Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Company Overview:Lean Tech is a rapidly expanding organization situated in Medellín, Colombia. We pride ourselves on possessing one of the most influential networks within software development and IT services for the entertainment, financial, and logistics sectors. Our corporate projections offer a multitude of opportunities for professionals to elevate their careers and experience substantial growth. Joining our team means engaging with expansive engineering teams across Latin America and the United States, contributing to cutting-edge developments in multiple industries.
Position Title:  Mid+ Site Reliability EngineerLocation: Remote - LATAM
What you will be doing:We are seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to drive reliability, scalability, and operational excellence across our SaaS platform. This role is critical in improving incident response, system observability, and performance optimization, while proactively preventing disruptions.As part of the Cloud Operations organization, you will lead post-incident investigations, implement preventative strategies, and partner with Engineering and Observability teams to enhance system resilience. You will also play a key role in building automation, improving time-to-resolution (TTR), and enabling a data-driven approach to reliability.
Requirements & Qualifications To excel in this role, you should possess:
  • Strong expertise in SRE practices, incident management, and production operations.
  • Hands-on experience with observability tools such as:
    • New Relic
    • Datadog
    • Sumo Logic
    • or similar platforms
  • Proficiency in programming/scripting (e.g., JavaScript, .NET, SQL).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred, Azure acceptable).
  • Strong understanding of SaaS architectures and distributed systems.
    Experience troubleshooting C#/.NET web applications and performance issues.
Nice to Have:
  • Experience with:
    • CI/CD pipelines
    • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation)
  • Strong troubleshooting experience in:
    • Windows environments
    • SQL Server
  • Previous experience as a:
    • Software Engineer
    • System Administrator
Soft Skills:
  • Strong analytical and data-driven problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous or evolving environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.
Why you will love Lean Tech:
  • Join a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology
  • Professional development opportunities with international customers
  • Collaborative work environment
  • Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels. 
Join Lean Tech and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
Join one of the most exciting early-stage platforms as we scale our engineering team globally.


You’ll be building on your full-stack experience, evolving a platform that balances cutting-edge tech with real-world stability. We are looking for a pragmatic \"builder\" who is comfortable in a fast-moving, early-stage environment and can take a feature from a raw idea to a polished delivery.


This is a 100% remote contract role (PJ) for a developer based in Brazil, reporting to our US/UK-based leadership. You’ll be central to our product delivery, working across the entire stack to ensure our users have a seamless, reliable experience.


Some of your day-to-day will be:

  • Full-Stack Development: Owning features from end-to-end using TypeScript and React.
  • Backend & Data: Building and maintaining robust services with Postgres and integrating third-party APIs.
  • Product Evolution: Supporting ongoing feature delivery and improving stability across key user flows.
  • Code Quality: Contributing to a maintainable codebase as the platform grows, balancing speed with long-term reliability.
  • Smart Engineering: Utilizing modern tools and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate delivery without losing sight of fundamental coding principles.


Requirements:

  • Mid-to-Senior Experience: Strong background in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks (React).
  • Database Fluency: Proven experience with relational databases (Postgres or similar).
  • Startup Mindset: Someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment where requirements evolve.
  • Independent Operator: Able to take ownership of tasks and work autonomously to hit delivery goals.
  • Communicator: Professional English proficiency (written and spoken) to collaborate with our international team.
  • Pragmatic: A focus on \"what works\" and \"what scales,\" avoiding over-engineering where it isn’t needed.


Benefits:

  • International Contract (PJ): Competitive remuneration.
  • 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in Brazil.
  • Direct Impact: Work directly with the founding team; no layers of middle management.
  • Modern Stack: Access to the latest development tools and a clean, high-velocity environment.
  • Growth: Opportunity to grow alongside the platform as we scale.

title: Customer Operations & Finance Support
description:
We are looking for an experienced Customer Operations & Finance Support professional to join our team and play a key role in managing premium enterprise customer accounts within a structured ITIL‑based operations model.


This role combines customer service leadership, finance & accounting ownership, and IT service management , making it ideal for someone who enjoys working across functions, engaging with senior stakeholders, and driving operational excellence in a multinational environment.


Your role and responsabilities:


  • Create, update, and manage customer data within internal ITIL tools to support end‑to‑end service workflows
  • Own and manage the financial health of customer accounts , including:
  • Monthly Balance Sheet preparation & review
  • Account reconciliations
  • P&L analysis and variance explanations
  • Perform financial analysis and reporting to support business and management decisions
  • Lead customer onboarding and offboarding for SAP ECS accounts , coordinating with cross‑functional stakeholders
  • Work directly with Premium Customers , ensuring a high‑quality, reliable service experience
  • Monitor customer service metrics, analyze trends, and take proactive actions to improve delivery
  • Measure, track, and improve overall customer experience levels
  • Analyze support workflows and propose improvements for efficiency and effectiveness
  • Manage support operations in a 24x5 model , ensuring smooth workload handovers and SLA compliance
  • Develop, document, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
  • Support management with forecasting, budgeting , and performance tracking vs. plan
  • Lead and support customer service teams through transitions, service introductions, or operational changes
  • Collaborate closely with senior management to align customer service outcomes with company goals


✅ What You Bring


  • Experience working in an Operations Support model
  • Advanced English
  • Strong experience in frontline customer management , including executive‑level interactions
  • Proven experience managing Finance & Accounting aspects of customer accounts
  • Hands‑on experience with ITIL processes , including:
  • Incident Management
  • Service Request Management
  • Change Management
  • Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data analysis and reporting
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team
  • Experience working in a multinational or cross‑cultural environment


Nice to Have


  • Project management experience in service transition and/or service introduction
  • Experience with common customer service and ITSM tools
  • Exposure to enterprise or SAP‑based customer environments


Please submit resumé in English

title: Data Analyst
description:
POSITION SUMMARY


Our client is a rapidly growing Microsoft 365 and Workplace Management consultancy with offices in the UK, Asia and LATAM. They are 100% committed to fostering the growth and development of all our team members. They offer a range of professional development opportunities to support both permanent staff and contractors in advancing their skills and careers. Through training programs, mentorship, and access to industry resources, they ensure that everyone has the tools and support needed to succeed and grow within the organisation.


They are looking for someone who is versatile, with great analysis and documentation skills to work with our project teams to develop data solutions and carry out analysis for our customers. Excellent English-speaking skills and a flexible attitude are a must!


Candidates MUST be located and living in Brazil. Applications from other countries will be immediately rejected.

RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Analyse, clean and organize raw data from multiple sources
  • Model and display data with storytelling back to the business and to the programme team
  • Explain and present technical information to non-experts and support and coach users on technologies
  • Produce and maintain dashboard reports on project and data migration activity
  • Troubleshoot Excel related issues such as macros and linked files
  • Carry out ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes for related data migration projects
  • Create and maintain adhoc and operational reports
  • Troubleshoot data migration issues as and when required


EXPERIENCE


  • Minimum 2 years working as a Data Analyst
  • 2 years experience creating and deploying custom PowerBI dashboards
  • Experience working on IT infrastructure projects (desirable)
  • Experience working with Microsoft 365 data (desirable)
  • Experience working in data migration projects and ETL processes
  • Experience developing and maintaining Management Information (MI) reports


QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS


  • Business/B2+ Level English
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • High level of numeracy and attention to detail
  • Advanced Excel skills (advanced formulas, pivot tables, macros/VBA)
  • Strong PowerBI (PowerQuery, M, DAX)
  • Microsoft Fabric
  • Strong analytical and documentation skills
  • Python Scripting skills (Pandas, NumPy, Seaborn, Matplotlib)
  • PowerShell scripting (desirable)
  • SQL skills (desirable)
  • Developer skills (desirable)
  • Microsoft Dataverse (desirable)
  • Microsoft Intelligent Data Platform (desirable)
  • Good PowerPoint and presentation skills
  • Experience working with IT systems and related projects (desirable)
  • Motivated self-starter
  • Personable and professional manner


Our client actively encourages applications from individuals with disabilities and try to provide access, adjustments, equipment, or other practical support where required. They welcome applications from people with backgrounds that are traditionally underrepresented in tech and truly believe diversity is the key to creativity and innovation.

title: Technical Support Analyst (SAP ATLAS)
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and detail‑oriented IT Technical Support Engineer to join our ATLAS (Automation of Customer Life Cycle across SAP) team.

In this role, you will play a critical part in supporting the end‑to‑end lifecycle of SAP solution landscapes for enterprise customers — from onboarding through offboarding. You’ll work across teams to ensure landscapes are accurately configured, monitored, and transitioned through key lifecycle stages while delivering high‑quality, reliable support.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys problem‑solving, collaboration, and ownership , and who thrives in a fast‑paced, customer‑focused environment.


Your role and responsabilities:


  • Manage and drive resolution of customer issues in collaboration with internal and external support teams
  • Investigate and resolve tickets raised via Jira (and soon ServiceNow )
  • Validate customer landscape configurations, lifecycle statuses, and key milestones using internal tools
  • Identify root causes of discrepancies (e.g., incorrect system statuses, missing dates) and implement corrective actions
  • Coordinate with internal and customer‑facing units (CFUs) to ensure clear ownership and timely resolution
  • Ensure operational data (fulfilment dates, landscape statuses, etc.) is accurate and compliant with internal policies
  • Support reliability and availability efforts aligned with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles
  • Document solutions and contribute to knowledge bases, process wikis, and operational documentation
  • Mentor new team members during onboarding, feature rollouts, or process changes
  • Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities to enhance efficiency and service quality
  • Create and analyze reports using Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint to track trends and performance metrics


Qualifications and Requirements:


  • Experience in IT Technical Support, customer operations, or enterprise system support
  • Advanced English
  • Exposure to ITSM frameworks (e.g., ITIL)
  • Hands‑on experience supporting at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
  • Experience working in or alongside Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams
  • Strong analytical and logical thinking skills for troubleshooting complex issues
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non‑technical teams
  • Familiarity with ticketing tools such as Jira or ServiceNow
  • Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast‑paced, high‑volume environment
  • A strong sense of ownership with a proactive approach to problem‑solving and process improvement
  • Willingness to learn complex systems and contribute to continuous operational improvement


Nice to Have


  • Understanding of SLA/KPI‑driven operations
  • Familiar with SAP ATLAS
  • Experience supporting enterprise B2B software solutions , ideally SAP‑related.


Please submite resumé in English

You’ll work across teams to ensure landscapes are accurately configured, monitored, and transitioned through key lifecycle stages while delivering high‑quality, reliable support.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys problem‑solving, collaboration, and ownership , and who thrives in a fast‑paced, customer‑focused environment.


Your role and responsabilities:


  • Manage and drive resolution of customer issues in collaboration with internal and external support teams
  • Investigate and resolve tickets raised via Jira (and soon ServiceNow )
  • Validate customer landscape configurations, lifecycle statuses, and key milestones using internal tools
  • Identify root causes of discrepancies (e.g., incorrect system statuses, missing dates) and implement corrective actions
  • Coordinate with internal and customer‑facing units (CFUs) to ensure clear ownership and timely resolution
  • Ensure operational data (fulfilment dates, landscape statuses, etc.) is accurate and compliant with internal policies
  • Support reliability and availability efforts aligned with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles
  • Document solutions and contribute to knowledge bases, process wikis, and operational documentation
  • Mentor new team members during onboarding, feature rollouts, or process changes
  • Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities to enhance efficiency and service quality
  • Create and analyze reports using Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint to track trends and performance metrics


Qualifications and Requirements:


  • Experience in IT Technical Support, customer operations, or enterprise system support
  • Advanced English
  • Exposure to ITSM frameworks (e.g., ITIL)
  • Hands‑on experience supporting at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
  • Experience working in or alongside Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams
  • Strong analytical and logical thinking skills for troubleshooting complex issues
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non‑technical teams
  • Familiarity with ticketing tools such as Jira or ServiceNow
  • Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast‑paced, high‑volume environment
  • A strong sense of ownership with a proactive approach to problem‑solving and process improvement
  • Willingness to learn complex systems and contribute to continuous operational improvement


Nice to Have


  • Understanding of SLA/KPI‑driven operations
  • Familiar with SAP ATLAS
  • Experience supporting enterprise B2B software solutions , ideally SAP‑related.

title: Analista de P&D - Golang/C++
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Golang/C++



Resumo do Propósito da Função:

Esta função oferece uma empolgante posição de desenvolvimento de software na equipe de Engenharia, uma organização multicultural com times baseados na Europa e na América do Sul, responsável por pesquisar e desenvolver soluções de hardware e software para sistemas de medição de audiência utilizados globalmente.

Este profissional fará parte da equipe responsável pelos sistemas de correspondência de áudio desenvolvidos pelo IBOPE, que estão sendo implementados em diversos países. Esse sistema compara áudios coletados por dispositivos de medição dedicados com uma biblioteca de conteúdos de TV, utilizando a tecnologia proprietária de correspondência de áudio do IBOPE (técnica de fingerprinting).

O IBOPE possui sistemas desenvolvidos tanto para ambientes on-premises quanto em nuvem, utilizando uma abordagem agnóstica de cloud. Sua arquitetura é composta por diversas tecnologias de ponta, como containers, Kubernetes, entre outras.



Esta função envolve:

  • Manutenção de tecnologias existentes baseadas em Linux para ambientes on-premises.
  • Pesquisa, criação e desenvolvimento de aplicações — baseadas em charts do Kubernetes e/ou disponíveis na CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) — responsáveis por comunicação, busca otimizada em grandes volumes de dados, armazenamento de dados e mais, utilizando tecnologias e técnicas avançadas.
  • Manutenção de pipelines.
  • Melhoria do código por meio da adição de ferramentas para avaliação da qualidade do código.



RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Manter tecnologias existentes implantadas em vários países.
  • Implementar novas tecnologias para sistemas de medição de audiência com base em tecnologias existentes e novas.
  • Pesquisar novas tecnologias para aprimorar o produto.
  • Desenvolver novos serviços.
  • Criar novos charts do Kubernetes.
  • Garantir a comunicação dos containers Kubernetes dentro e fora dos clusters.
  • Manter a tecnologia atual.




REQUISITOS:


Essencial:

  • Superior completo ou cursando último ano na área de tecnologia.
  • Experiência com Linux / bash scripting.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em C++ and/or Golang
  • TDD – metodologia de testes
  • Experiência com SQL database e NoSQL database.
  • Inglês avançado para conversas técnicas e documentação.



Desejável:

  • Javascript
  • Kubernetes
  • AKS
  • Terraform
  • Monitoring systems
  • Prometheus Stack
  • Messaging (RabbitMQ)




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Consultor fiscal
description:
Make this the place where you grow!


Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Somos uma equipe de pessoas apaixonadas que impulsionam a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e muito mais. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e ServiceNow, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas – e para suas pessoas,


Com operações em mais de 30 países e reunindo 18.500 especialistas representando mais de 90 países, permitimos que milhares de empresas se tornassem mais eficientes e eficazes nas últimas três décadas.


Fazemos parte da NTT DATA, líder de US$ 30+ bilhões em serviços empresariais e tecnológicos, IA e infraestrutura digital, atendendo 75% da Fortune Global 100. title: Desenvolvedor Cobol Mainframe
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Se você gosta de atuar com desenvolvimento e manutenção em ambientes mainframe, lidando com sistemas críticos e alta volumetria...

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Cobol com experiência em DB2 e forte atuação em ajustes estruturais e evolução de sistemas...

Se você domina Cobol, SQL e análise de impacto em sistemas legados, essa oportunidade é para você.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar alterações em tabelas DB2 para adequação ao formato de CNPJ alfanumérico
  • Analisar impactos e ajustar programas Cobol existentes
  • Atuar na manutenção e atualização de artefatos como Books e Sysins
  • Desenvolver e ajustar rotinas e procedimentos em SQL / Proc SQL
  • Apoiar testes técnicos, validações e homologações
  • Acompanhar processos de implantação em produção
  • Garantir a integridade e consistência dos dados durante as alterações
  • Identificar riscos e impactos em sistemas legados
  • Atuar na correção de incidentes e melhorias evolutivas
  • Colaborar com times técnicos e áreas envolvidas no projeto


Habilidades e Requisitos

  • Experiência como Desenvolvedor Cobol em ambiente Mainframe
  • Conhecimento sólido em DB2
  • Experiência com SQL e Proc SQL
  • Vivência em manutenção e evolução de sistemas legados
  • Experiência com análise de impacto e ajustes em programas Cobol
  • Conhecimento em manipulação de tabelas e dados em ambientes críticos
  • Experiência com testes, validação e implantação de sistemas
  • Boa comunicação e atenção a detalhes
  • Perfil proativo, confiável e com senso de responsabilidade


Diferencial

  • Experiência em projetos de CNPJ alfanumérico
  • Vivência anterior no Banco Safra
  • Certificação em linguagem Cobol ou tecnologias correlatas
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em ambientes financeiros/bancários
  • Experiência com grandes volumes de dados e sistemas críticos


Formato de trabalho

  • 100% REMOTO.


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!
